messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] P1 - dedicated-pool node instability detected: pool=aurora-dp-2 node=node-1987 GPU0 ECC spikes + kernel-reset. Paged to on-call team.
Lina (oncall): ack — I'm on it, pulling logs and metrics now.
Lina (oncall): @Raj (cust-eng) can you confirm this is AuroraCorp's VPC dedicated pool? any visible customer reports?
Raj (cust-eng): yes — aurora-dp-2 is theirs. They reported intermittent 502/503s on long-running inferences starting ~03:08Z. CSM already pinged me.
Marcus: quick look at infra — node-1987 jumped to DEGRADED, kube drained some pods, but a few sessions migrated causing 5xx spikes.
Lina (oncall): grabbing node events. CLI snippet:
```bash
$ rctl pool aurora-dp-2 nodes --id node-1987 --events
2026-03-15T03:07:49Z pci-e_aer: correctable-errors x214
2026-03-15T03:08:03Z gpu0: ECC spikes -> gpu-reset
2026-03-15T03:08:15Z kernel: GPU driver panic -> node evict
```
Anya (eng-runtime): thanks. Looks like repeatable ECC/KVM issues on GPU0. Replacement path available — we can force-replace the node and bootstrap with image v3.2.1. Will skip KV warmup to speed up if acceptable.
Tim SRE: I'm seeing a concurrent spot-price surge in us-west-2, preemption windows around 03:10Z — possible spot interruption + hardware fault.
Lina (oncall): plan: 1) Isolate node-1987 (no new sessions), 2) route AuroraCorp traffic to remaining healthy nodes / reserved fallback, 3) replace node-1987 with fresh instance, 4) monitor for regression. @Anya please confirm replace ETA.
Anya (eng-runtime): confirm. replace job queued. Estimated time to healthy ~ 18-25 minutes (image pull + attach GPUs + boot). I'll push bootstrap without KV cache to cut ~6-8 minutes.
Kelsey (CSM): notifying AuroraCorp now. Telling them we have a mitigation path and ETA ~25m. They asked for RTO estimate and whether we can reduce impact now.
Lina (oncall): immediate mitigation executed: routing-policy update to bias traffic away from node-1987 and to reserved fallback pool for AuroraCorp. Results: error rate down from ~5% to ~0.6% in metrics stream.
Raj (cust-eng): customer reports decreased failures but still seeing a handful of timeouts on long jobs. They want confirm on session state loss (KV cache).
Anya (eng-runtime): note — skipping KV warmup will cause cold-cache on replaced node but routing to fallback nodes preserves most sessions. We'll capture golden prompts to verify quality.
Marcus: running health checks on pool after routing change. A few pods report EOF on socket during migration — likely in-flight sessions lost.
Lina (oncall): executing drain/replace commands now: 
```bash
rctl node drain node-1987 --force --no-new-sessions --timeout 300
rctl node replace node-1987 --image redwood-runtime:v3.2.1 --skip-kv-warmup
```
oncall-bot: job replace-node-8842 created, status=queued. Progress updates will follow.
ops-bot: autoscaler note — nodes in aurora-dp-2 scaled up by 2 to absorb load.
Tim SRE: I'll watch model evals and observability dashboards. enabling canary fallback to smaller model for AuroraCorp (lower mem footprint) to reduce churn.
Kelsey (CSM): AuroraCorp on the call says SLA impact window is concerning; asked if we can provide interim mitigation like per-request retries.
Lina (oncall): enabling per-request client retries + 503->retry mapping at edge for the tenant temporarily.
Raj (cust-eng): confirmed per-request retries in place, monitoring customer metrics. They still want post-incident analysis of session continuity.
Anya (eng-runtime): replacement in progress — attaching GPUs. Watch for firmware mismatch — we've seen BMC/factory firmware causing kernel panics in last quarter.
Marcus: replacement job moved to in-progress. Node boots, kube join started.
Lina (oncall): update to customer: "We've isolated faulty node and routed your traffic; replacement underway, expected full service in 20-30 minutes. We'll share a timeline and next steps"
Kelsey (CSM): customer acknowledged, asking for notification when KV warmup complete.
Tim SRE: initial post-replace healthchecks passing. Will run golden prompt evals to validate inference quality and latency.
Anya (eng-runtime): replaced node active and ready. Note: KV cache cold on this node. Recommend gradual traffic ramp to rewarm caches.
Lina (oncall): ramping traffic back slowly to avoid spikes. Monitoring error rate and latency.
Raj (cust-eng): customer reports errors at ~0.2% now, acceptable for them for the moment. They asked for a brief summary and root-cause follow-up.
Lina (oncall): creating incident ticket INC-2026-2745 with timeline, commands executed, and immediate mitigations (routing change, per-request retries, fallback pool, node replace).
Tim SRE: handoff to night on-call in 10m — I'll continue to monitor. All set from infra side.
Lina (oncall): handing off to @Tim SRE. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: incident status -> mitigated (P2), monitoring.
Kelsey (CSM): AuroraCorp CSM says they're satisfied for now, will reopen if >1% errors.
Lina (oncall): closing Slack thread, updates will continue in INC-2026-2745.
